title: Brilliant
body: Exactly what I needed personally to manage my daily tasks and routines. Has helped me so far to avoid alcohol and cut back on Nicotine. Definitely recommended if you find it hard to do daily or weekly tasks and have tendencies to miss or skip some of you basic tasks

title: Love this and use it every day
body: This is one of my favourite apps - I use it everyday! It’s easy to set up and use and I love how tasks appear as a red notification on my Home Screen until they are complete.

title: Amazing app!
